sc: A critic's review (article 5) can be obtained from excavating at the Senntisten Dig Site at the citizen remains excavation hotspots.
They are a possible reward from opening medium reward caskets as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion, or from cremating at the Columbarium.
Trimmed adamant armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be trimmed by any players.

u: Refined anima core helm of Sliske
sc: It can be made by combining a dormant anima core helm with a Crest of Sliske.

It can be upgraded to a refined anima core helm of Sliske using 1 of each of Serenic, Sliskean, Zamorakian, and Zarosian essences, after the ability to craft refined anima core of Sliske armour has been unlocked by earning 750 Sliskean reputation.
The blueprints for the master farmer outfit must first be purchased from Granny Potterington at the Farmers' Market for 1,000 beans.
They can be traded, but only for other master farmer outfit pieces.
Two of them are obtained, along with other items, at a cost of 10% charges of a Guardian's Gift by selecting the Entrepreneur's Wish.
Arcane Apprentice Shoes is a feet slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Potion Pandemonium promotion on Treasure Hunter.
Argonite platebody is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
The augmented Consecrated keris is an item created by using an augmentor on a consecrated keris or obtained by killing the 200th Elite Profane Scabarite with an augmented Primed keris equipped.

u: Augmented elite tectonic robe bottom (Third Age)
sc: It is made by augmenting an elite tectonic robe bottom at an inventor's workbench.
Alternatively, it may be created by upgrading an augmented tectonic robe bottom with at least 95% charge.

sc: They can be made at a forge and anvil using 1 bane bar, requiring 900 progress to complete, granting a total of 700 Smithing experience.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bane bars, requiring 1,800 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,400 Smithing experience.

Barbarian assault ticket - wave 8.x: The Barbarian assault ticket - wave 8 is an item that is obtained from Captain Cain or Commander Connad by requesting to change your current wave in Barbarian Assault from wave eight back to wave one, or attempting to enter the wave one lobby.

sc: The basic decorative shield is a shield that can be bought as a reward from Lanthus for 6 silver Castle wars tickets and requires a Defence level of 20 to wear.

Battle Robes (Cruor) Gloves.x: Battle Robes (Cruor) Gloves is a hands slot cosmetic override. It is part of the Battle Robes (Cruor) set.

sc: It can be created by giving a black dragonhide and 20 coins to a tanner, or by using the Make Leather spell at level 83 Magic.
Tanners can be found in Al Kharid, the Ranging Guild, Varrock, Taverley, Canifis, Prifddinas, Wendlewick, and the Crafting Guild.
The black candle lantern is a type of lantern created with the Firemaking skill by using a black candle with a candle lantern (empty).
To make a black candle lantern, the player must first have an unlit black candle, a candle lantern frame (made with the Crafting skill) and at least level 4 Firemaking.
Cauldron Maul is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override which can be redeemed with 300 candy corn, obtained from Treasure Hunter between 29 October and 4 November 2015.
As it is drawn directly on a glyph spot, players cannot obtain it as an item.

tx:
When harvesting from a wisp or a spring, a chronicle fragment may spawn and prompt the following message: . It will then appear as an interactive scenery object to be clicked. On spawn the chronicle will be temporarily instanced so that only the player for whom it spawned may see it, but after a short while, other players will be able to catch it (excluding Ironmen and Hardcore Ironmen). The chronicle can get stuck under the springs or other objects and appear to be invisible, so it can be helpful to right click the area. Capturing the chronicle fragment manually within 6 seconds of it spawning will turn it into an enhanced chronicle fragment. Alternatively if the Chronicle Attraction curse or a spirit attraction potion is active when the chronicle fragment spawns, the chronicle will be automatically harvested and enhanced. Enhanced chronicle fragments do the same thing as regular fragments, but each one is more effective.
Prior to completion of the Memorial to Guthix tutorial, a maximum of 30 chronicle fragments may be possessed at once. Once players reach the limit, they will need to offer chronicles to an energy rift, May Stormbrewer, Eilwynn, or the Guthixian ruins in exchange for Divination experience before gathering more. This limit is removed after completing the Memorial to Guthix tutorial, at which point players are able to possess an unlimited number of fragments before turning them in. Another quest that affects chronicles is Fate of the Gods, as harvesting at the elder wisps on Freneskae will always grant elder chronicles instead.
The chronicle fragments spawn rate can be increased by three methods: 
1. Wearing a pontifex shadow ring (or the enriched version). 
2.…
sc: Chronicle fragments are randomly obtained Divination items that can be spent in certain ways for Divination benefits, such as buffs, enriched memories, and experience.

An alternative method of obtaining chronicles is available when the Voice of Seren is active in the Amlodd district, shadow creatures in Prifddinas have a chance to spawn a chronicle fragment when killed.
A clay ring (unfired) is made by moulding soft clay with a ring mould.
Clue scroll (medium) is an emote clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
A creepy doll can be obtained by using ruined essence on Brother Celerity in Edgeville Monastery as part of the Mod Deg trading sequence.
Although the player will lose the doll, another can be obtained by getting another expired spin ticket and completing the trading sequence again.

u: Augmented hatchet of ember and glade
sc: It can be obtained by trading in a dragon hatchet, from either the backpack or the tool belt, and 4,000 harmonic dust to Lady Ithell in the Ithell district of Prifddinas.
The crystal axe (as hatchets were called at the time) was originally intended to release in 2006 as a reward from the The Eyes of Glouphrie quest.

Dervish hood (red).x: The red dervish hood is part of the dervish outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: A Divination lamp is awarded on completion of the One of a Kind quest as of 31 March 2014, and awards 5,000 Divination experience when rubbed.
The behaviour of this lamp, if obtained upon quest completion, in relation to its achievement is unknown; destroying this lamp before clicking to "rub" it may or may not complete the achievement.
The boots can be obtained as a reward from either Triskelion Treasures (unlocked using the Crystal triskelion) or as a very rare reward from the crystal chest.
While Triskelion Treasures and crystal chest are for members only, the boots can be traded to and worn by F2P (free-to-play) players as well.
They are obtained from the watchtower south of the quest start point.

Eastern skirt (green).x: The green eastern skirt is part of the eastern outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Emergency pocket sand is an item found in Evil Dave's bank during the Evil Dave's Big Day Out quest.
An enlightened amulet is made by enchanting a topaz amulet with the Lvl-3 Enchant spell.
The factory top is a reward from the Flash Powder Factory minigame and is part of the factory outfit.
It can be bought from Brian O'Richard for 3,000 Brian points or from Stanley Limelight for 350 thaler.
The guardian body is an item obtained after using Edvin's tool on rune essence during the quest Rune Mechanics.

The charge can be exchanged for wishes to boost the player's account, and the charge will not degrade over time or when destroying the item, but the item will be removed from the account once charge runs out.
Due to the limitations on the wishes, free-to-play ironman accounts are able to obtain the item, but will be unable to activate any of the wishes.

h: Via claiming a Herald's Outfit token (untradeable) obtained from one of Santa's Christmas Presents.
sc: They are unlocked by redeeming a Herald's Trousers and Boots token or the untradeable Herald's Outfit token.
Huge XP lamps were obtained by turning in 25,000 renown during the second world event, the Bird and the Beast.
It can be obtained by combining 1,000 Sacred metal fragments with an Infernal bowstaff.
Players obtain it by using Glough's key on the locked chest in Glough's home just south of the Grand Tree.
Ivory is an archaeology material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 52 Archaeology.
Red sandstone can be mined at Oo'glog and smelted using the robust glass machine also located at Oo'glog.
Juju hunter flask.x: A juju hunter flask is a potion flask originally containing six doses of juju hunter potion. It is created by using juju hunter potion on a potion flask. The flask is made by blowing robust glass, requiring 89 Crafting and giving 100 experience.

sc: The K'ril's Cleaver (also called Cleaver of Tsutsaroth in Solomon's General Store) is a cosmetic override available from Solomon's General Store.
It can replace the appearance of any single-handed melee weapon, and is unlocked with its off-hand variant.
Keggy is a keg pet obtained by redeeming a keg companion pet token from NovtumberFest.
The kratonite dagger is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
A large XP lamp (Construction) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter.
A large XP lamp (Summoning) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter.
The lucky chaotic crossbow is a piece of lucky equipment that can be won from Treasure Hunter from 13 March 2015 0:00 UTC onwards.
The gloves are obtained by combining the sapphire, emerald, and ruby golem gloves.

Malachite green is an Archaeological material that can be obtained through excavating material caches or various excavation sites, requiring level 76 Archaeology, at various dig sites around RuneScape.
It is not made from the mineral , but named after its similar colour.
The Medium Golden Gear Bundle is a pack containing cosmetic overrides and items that can be purchased from the Marketplace for £24.
A memory-storage bot (Juna) is given to the player by the Archivist in the Hall of Memories after handing in the memory-storage bot (Seren).
This action will also grant the player a reward of 30,000 Divination experience and unlock the permanent boost of having increased chance to spawn chronicle fragment while training Divination.
Message in a bottle is an item found on the northern shore of the first island in The Islands That Once Were Turtles network, by the mushroom patch.
On this island the player can talk to Azalea Oakheart, one of the ten castaways that are found in the arc.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 6 mithril bars and a mithril plateskirt + 1, requiring 1,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 720 Smithing experience.
Necromancy XP lamp is a reward item given upon completion of The Spirit of War quest.
It is found on the ground in the centre of the room.

The noxious scythe is a level 90 two-handed melee weapon that can be created at level 90 Crafting by combining a spider leg with Araxxi's fang, both of which are obtained by fighting Araxxor and Araxxi.
Observation: Husk is a memory found in JasKra's chamber during Heart of Stone.
The Ocean's Archer Bow is a two-handed Ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by using an Ocean's Archer Bow token or through the Ocean's archer override pack.
They are created by combining a strong melee potion, strong magic potion, strong ranged potion, strong necromancy potion, and strong defence potion.

Other types of pasty jogre bones can be created if the ingredients are combined in the wrong order, but the other types will also produce useless bad marinated jogre bones when heated.

The ring of charos (a)(i) was formerly obtained by providing a ring of charos (a) to one of the officers in the Officers' Tower while having 106,000 reward credits and 200+ rank from the Mobilising Armies minigame.
A ring of the Blighted is an item that can be obtained by exchanging 250 postage stamps.
They were previously commonly obtained when opening large parcels.
They can't be obtained as an item.
It is a possible reward from completing hard clue scrolls as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
Gilded rune armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be gilded by any players.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 rune bars and a rune square shield + 1, requiring 1,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 960 Smithing experience.
Sagittarian vambraces are a piece of the Tier 11 Sagittarian ranged armour set that is only available in the Dungeoneering skill.
They cannot be made by players and are only obtainable as a reward from Icy Bones.
Players may obtain bark by using a knife with the scrapey tree logs obtained from the facility's scrapey trees.
A security block is an item dropped by three of the pests during The Void Stares Back.
It is found by the player and a small group they lead in a dungeon, in a dead Seeker of Truth.

The shadow engrammeter (depleted) is a depleted version of the shadow engrammeter found by the player in the vault of Kharid-et Dig Site, after completing the vault's four puzzles, during The Vault of Shadows mystery.
The shark's tooth necklace can be obtained after playing the Fishing Trawler minigame.
It can be crafted by using 5 shark teeth received from the minigame, with some thread.
It is made by sharpening an unsharpened masterwork blade using a whetstone (item form included, which doesn't get consumed) or an armour stand in the workshop of a player-owned house.
It can be made into a masterwork 2h sword with a masterwork sword hilt.
Sheratan Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 4 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 45 of Zodiyak Track.
The other half of the shield is sold by Siegfried Erkle in the Legends' Guild Shop of Useful Items for 750,000 coins.
The shield left half may also be received as loot from kingly implings or seren spirits.
Shield of Hearts is a shield cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the King and Queen of Hearts Pack.
Shirt (female, yellow) is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
Upon receiving a piece from the ringmaster, it becomes available as a cosmetic override in the Customisation interface.
There are six types of shirts which may be awarded to players.
The spiritbloom orb is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 141 spirit shards, a blue charm, and a steel bar in the backpack, requiring 56 Summoning and giving 492.
It can be made into ten Steel Minotaur scrolls (Steel Bull Rush) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 5.
